description: Agent-based, networked simulation of mask-wearing adoption and adherence dynamics under peer influence, household/work norms, policy mandates and enforcement, media messaging, and retailer supply constraints. Agents interact across home, work/school, and public venues on a small-world social network.

parameters.information_sources: assign 1-3 MediaSource ids with probability proportional to source.reach

modules.name: MediaMessaging
modules.description: Broadcasts media messages that adjust individuals' risk perception and attitudes toward masking based on source tone, credibility, and campaign intensity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  sources = p.information_sources
  media_signal = 0
  for s in sources:
    tone = +1 if s.message_tone=='pro_mask' else -1 if 'anti_mask' else 0
    weight = s.credibility * s.reach_normalized * PolicyMaker.messaging_intensity
    media_signal += tone * weight
  media_signal = media_signal + Normal(0, message_noise_std)
  if mean_credibility(sources) < min_media_credibility: media_signal *= 0.5
  media_effect = media_effect_weight * tanh(media_signal)
  p.risk_perception_delta = media_effect
aggregate signal.media_attitude = population_mean(tanh(media_signal))
notes: Credibility and trust modulate uptake implicitly via p's source assignment

modules.name: PolicyEnforcement
modules.description: Activates mandates at workplaces and public venues and computes individual compliance pressure and noncompliance outcomes given enforcement strength and noise.

update_rule.pseudocode:
active = (day >= policy_start_day)
coverage = policy_mask_required_fraction if active else 0
for each location L in (WorkplaceSchool, PublicVenue):
  L.policy_mask_required = (rand() < coverage)
  L.enforcement_strength = enforcement_strength * PolicyMaker.enforcement_resources
for each person p:
  required_today = any(location.policy_mask_required for locations p attends today)
  pressure = 0
  if required_today:
    base = mean(enforcement_strength at p's attended locations)
    pressure = base * (0.5 + 0.5 * p.trust_in_institutions)
    pressure = max(0, pressure + Normal(0, enforcement_noise_std))
  signal.policy_pressure[p] = pressure
  # compute expected noncompliance
  expected_wear = min(1, p.adherence_probability + pressure)
  noncompliance = required_today and (expected_wear < 0.5)
aggregate observable.policy_noncompliance_rate_daily = mean(noncompliance)
notes: policy_pressure can be consumed by adoption decision
Simplified attendance for venues; see ContactsAndAdherence for actual contact hosting

modules.name: PeerInfluenceDecision
modules.description: Updates each person's adoption state and adherence probability using social influence from network and household norms, risk perception, and policy pressure with habit persistence.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  peer_share = mean(neighbor.adoption_state for neighbor in p.network_neighbors)
  hh_norm = Household[p.household_id].norms_mask
  workplace_norm = average_adoption_in(WorkplaceSchool[p.workplace_id]) if exists else 0
  x = 0
  x += social_influence_weight * ( (1 - p.social_influence_susceptibility) * peer_share + p.social_influence_susceptibility * hh_norm )
  x += normative_weight_workplace * workplace_norm
  x += risk_perception_weight * clamp01(p.risk_perception + p.risk_perception_delta)
  x += policy_effect_weight * signal.policy_pressure[p]
  # inertia / habit component
  prev = 1 if p.adoption_state else 0
  x = (1 - habit_persistence) * x + habit_persistence * prev + inertia_bias
  # stochastic discrete choice via logistic with temperature
  prob_adopt = sigmoid( (x - 0.5) / max(1e-3, decision_temperature) )
  p.adoption_state = (rand() < prob_adopt)
  # adherence update for adopters
  if p.adoption_state:
    base = 0.5 * (1 + signal.policy_pressure[p])
    adherence = clamp(min_adherence, max_adherence, 0.5*prev + 0.5*base + 0.25*peer_share + 0.25*hh_norm)
    p.adherence_probability = adherence
  else:
    p.adherence_probability = 0
  # update household norms as moving average
  Household[p.household_id].norms_mask = 0.8*hh_norm + 0.2*mean(adoption_state of household members)
notes: risk perception delta comes from MediaMessaging

modules.name: PurchasingAndInventory
modules.description: Determines demand for masks by individuals based on income affordability, risk, and target inventory; attempts purchases from retailers, updating mask_inventory.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  if day % purchase_interval_days != (p.id % purchase_interval_days): continue
  target = target_inventory_per_person * (1 + 0.5 * (p.risk_perception > hoarding_threshold_risk))
  needed = max(0, round(target - p.mask_inventory))
  if needed == 0: continue
  affordability = (mask_price * needed) <= (affordability_threshold_income_fraction * p.income / 365)
  propensity = purchase_propensity = 0.3 + 0.4 * (p.risk_perception) + 0.3 * (1 - (p.mask_inventory/ (target+1e-6)))
  propensity *= (1 if affordability else demand_sensitivity_income * (p.income / max_income))
  if rand() < propensity:
    qty = clamp(0, needed, round(Normal(purchase_quantity_mean, purchase_quantity_std)))
    retailer = select_retailer_with_stock(qty)
    if retailer:
      buy = min(qty, retailer.inventory)
      cost = buy * retailer.price
      if cost <= (affordability_threshold_income_fraction * p.income / 365) or affordability:
        retailer.inventory -= buy
        p.mask_inventory += buy
observable.mask_availability_rate_daily = mean(p.mask_inventory > 0)
notes: max_income is precomputed from population for normalization
Retailer selection can be nearest or random with probability proportional to inventory

modules.name: RetailerSupply
modules.description: Restocks retailers and updates prices using inventory gap and demand pressure via simple price elasticity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each retailer r:
  desired = retailer_initial_inventory_per_capita * population_size / n_retailers
  gap = desired - r.inventory
  restock = max(0, restock_rate * gap)
  r.inventory += restock
  # price adjustment
  inv_ratio = r.inventory / max(1, desired)
  r.price = clamp(min_price, max_price, mask_price * (1 + price_markup_elasticity * (1 - inv_ratio)))
notes: mask_price is the base price; price adjusts with scarcity
restock_rate can be <1 to represent constraints

modules.name: ContactsAndAdherence
modules.description: Generates expected contacts at home/work/community per person and applies adherence probability to estimate wearing in contacts; provides exposure feedback for norms.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  c_home = contact_rate_home
  c_work = contact_rate_work * (WorkplaceSchool[p.workplace_id].contact_rate_modifier if exists else 0)
  c_comm = contact_rate_community * public_venue_contact_rate_modifier
  expected_wear_prob = p.adoption_state * p.adherence_probability
  masked_contacts = expected_wear_prob * (c_home + c_work + c_comm)
  signal.exposure_masked_contacts[p] = masked_contacts
observable.adherence_probability_mean_daily = mean(p.adherence_probability where p.adoption_state==true)
notes: No disease model here; only expected mask wearing in contacts

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily adoption-related observables and summary statistics (peak, time-to-target, sustained duration, inequality by income).

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily[t] = mean(p.adoption_state * p.adherence_probability)
mask_availability_rate_daily[t] = mean(p.mask_inventory > 0)
adherence_probability_mean_daily already provided
if t == end:
  peak_adoption_rate = max_t(adoption_rate_daily[t])
  first_t70 = first t where adoption_rate_daily[t] >= adoption_target_threshold
  time_to_target_adoption_70 = (first_t70 if exists else null)
  sustained_adoption_duration_above_70 = count of t >= first_t70 with adoption_rate_daily[t] >= adoption_target_threshold
  # Gini by income quintiles for adoption probability
  group adoption by income quintile; compute G = 1 - sum_i( (S_i + S_{i-1}) * p_i ) where S_i cumulative share
  adoption_inequality_gini_income_daily[t] = G_t per day
notes: Adoption rate is expected fraction wearing masks during contacts (adoption_state * adherence_probability)
Gini computed over adoption probability by income groups

initialization.household_assignment: Greedy fill households by size distribution and sort by income for mild assortativity
initialization.workplace_assignment: Sample workplaces by capacity; students to schools by age 5-22
initialization.public_venue_catalog: Generate venues by type with capacities
initialization.policy_maker: Single policymaker with schedule starting day 14
initialization.media_sources: Create 5 sources with reach Dirichlet and tone distribution
initialization.retailers: Create n_retailers=max(10,N/1000) with initial inventory and price
initialization.person_initial_states: Sample attributes as specified, set initial adoption at given rate and adherence for adopters
initialization.income_bins: Compute quantile bins for gini computation

algorithms.network_generation: Watts-Strogatz small-world graph with N nodes, k=average_degree, beta=0.05
algorithms.adoption_decision: Discrete-choice logistic with features: social influence, household norm, workplace norm, risk perception, policy pressure; inertia via habit_persistence
algorithms.policy_activation: Bernoulli activation of location policy by coverage fraction; enforcement pressure as product of strength and trust
algorithms.media_update: Weighted tone aggregation with reach and credibility, applying tanh squashing
algorithms.purchase_decision: Threshold affordability check plus propensity function using risk and inventory gap; Gaussian-rounded quantity
algorithms.restock_and_pricing: Inventory gap proportional restock; scarcity-based price markup with caps
algorithms.aggregation: Daily computation of observables; post-run summary stats and income-based Gini
